events.detail: The first invocation used the target worktree, which contained the protected pre-existing modification Wordpress/dist/marketlense.zip. The runner refused a measured run before provider submission.
events.resolution: A separate clean detached producer worktree at the fixed producer SHA was used. The protected ZIP was not changed, staged or removed.

events.detail: The first provider preflight ran before the ignored local environment file was available in the clean producer worktree and therefore returned policy_blocked for all five members.
events.resolution: The ignored local environment configuration was copied into the clean producer worktree without exposing or committing secrets; the preflight then admitted all five sources.
